design_name: Minimal-Diff Hybrid: re-enable the existing cvar-gated unarmed layer on top of engine parity, plus four micro-fixes and three one-line loud hooks
architecture:
PRINCIPLE: almost everything required already exists in the working tree; the experimental layer was reverted by config, not deleted. The design is (A) flip ONE cvar back on, (B) keep the retired whole-window cvar OFF forever, (C) apply four recorded micro-fixes, (D) add ~6 lines of new glue for the loud transition, (E) one already-designed one-line engine retarget.

LAYER 1 - ENGINE TRUTH (already shipped, zero change): g_coopDisgParity=1 recomputes m_bIsDisguised per frame in every gametype (player.cpp:5482-5511, holster/InventoryItem=disguised, draw=blown, alarm=never, attacker veto requires GetCurrentThreat()>0 per bug-1631). This IS the vanilla SP disguise contract, now live in coop. Scripts only ever write has_disguise; is_disguised is read-only truth.

LAYER 2 - UNARMED LIFECYCLE (already implemented, re-enabled by config): flipping coop_stealthStart 0->1 re-activates the map-load trio arming at m2l2a.scr:38-42 (level.coop_noWeapon + coop_startUnarmed + coop_forcePapersEquip set before any player spawns). All eight grant sites already consult coop_noWeapon (managePlayerInventory:745 exit, spawnWeaponAssert, backfillPrimaries, giveSidearmPick, dbno_enter:231 pistol, dbno_ai_revive:728, medkit self-revive:376, armOnBlown itself), so first spawn, death respawn, DBNO, spectate return, reconnect and late join are all unarmed with NO new code. The per-body stealth block at itemhandler.scr:710-742 (deliberately ABOVE the early-exit) re-establishes the engine has_disguise latch + papers item + papersAnytime + papers-in-hand on every new body, covering respawners and late joiners.

LAYER 3 - SQUAD SHARE (already implemented, zero change): items.scr uniform pickup -> giveUniformToAll + giveDisguiseToAll; papers pickups -> givePapersFlagToAll; level.papers is level-global by vanilla design (one pickup upgrades the team); late joiners inherit via level.coop_itemPapers/coop_enableDisguises through the Layer-2 block.

LAYER 4 - AGGRO GATES (already implemented cvar-free, one parity completion): coop_stealthBlocksAggro + canseeUndisguisedPlayers + the alarm_system alerted-guard all defer per-target to engine is_disguised (bug-1639). coop_stealthNoAggro stays 0 permanently - whole-window gating is retired (ledger: superseded design). Micro-fix: disguiseHandler:1021 still reads the mod flag; move it to the engine getter.

LAYER 5 - LOUD MACHINE (small new glue, see loud_state_machine): coop_armOnBlown is the single one-way arm funnel; it already hangs off takeAllDisguises (alarm master, uniform removal), naxos caught, and blown-on-damage. New: three one-line hooks so DETECTION (not just damage) goes loud - disguise_enemy.scr and disguise_halt.scr coop preambles + top of ohnothenaxos1's coop branch each thread coop_armOnBlown (self-gated on coop_startUnarmed==1, NIL-inert on every other map). disguise_deny.scr is deliberately NOT hooked - vanilla DENY is a non-hostile wave-off.

LAYER 6 - ENGINE MICRO-CHANGE (the only engine edit): E1 from the master plan - PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise's sight trace (actor.cpp ~9039) retargeted from hard-coded G_GetEntity(0)->centroid to m_Enemy->centroid, guarded by m_Enemy!=NULL and the existing g_coopDisgParity cvar (no new cvar). Without it, guards only initiate papers checks on clients 2-4 when the HOST's chest is traceable, and an empty slot 0 is a crash site. game.dll-only; ships to BOTH roots per bug-1634 with a string-scan verification per bug-1635.
per_expectation: E1 UNARMED ACROSS ALL LIFECYCLE EVENTS: satisfied entirely by re-enabling coop_stealthStart. The trio is level-scoped so it survives every player entity destruction (reconnect, late join); every body funnels through managePlayerInventory whose :745 coop_noWeapon exit blocks the grant, and DBNO pistol (dbno.scr:231), both revive chains (dbno.scr:728, medkit.scr:376) and the late fallback raisers are all already gated on the same flag. After papers/disguise pickup players stay unarmed because pickup never clears the trio (only coop_armOnBlown does), and coop_stealthStripWeapons at the uniform scene (m2l2a.scr:833) plus the 2Hz coop_stealthHoldDisguise watchdog contain world-pickup leakage. Zero new code.

E2 ONE PICKUP ARMS THE WHOLE SQUAD WITH THE DISGUISE: satisfied by existing code. likeynorway -> items.scr add_item uniform+papers_level1 -> giveUniformToAll + giveDisguiseToAll (engine has_disguise latch under the changeGameType window) + givePapersFlagToAll; level.papers is global by vanilla design; every LATER body (respawn/join/reconnect) re-acquires latch+papers via the itemhandler.scr:710-742 block, which is why it sits above the early-exit. Zero new code.

E3 ALL PLAYERS FIRE TO SHOW PAPERS, NEVER BREAKING CHECKS: coop_papersAnytime (itemhandler.scr:1207, primaryfire-while-unarmed, NIL and NULL both guarded per bug-1603) gives show-on-demand; enableClickablePapers covers the interrogation window; the engine handshake is already per-player-correct (papers item stamps the OWNER's m_ShowPapersTime, frames 30-70). Two fixes complete this: (a) the E1 engine retarget so challenges INITIATE against whichever player is the enemy, not only when the host is traceable; (b) the coop_paperPassAll deferral so an accepting guard is never frozen mid-ACCEPT (bug-1631) - he finishes his accept anim, demotes naturally, then retires via type_disguise none once his thinkstate has left disguise.

E4 WRONG-PAPERS DETECTION GOES LOUD WITH LOADOUTS FOREVER AFTER: the engine officer/rover Fake_Papers dead-end and sentry ENEMY path are untouched (vanilla alert behavior, per expectation 6). NEW GLUE: one line in anim/disguise_enemy.scr and anim/disguise_halt.scr coop preambles threads itemhandler::coop_armOnBlown (idempotent, self-gated on coop_startUnarmed==1) - the guard entering ENEMY/HALT is exactly the detected-as-spy moment, and players are armed during the 3s/1.5s grace before his ATTACK, not after first damage. coop_armOnBlown atomically clears the trio (verified :1395-1401, flags BEFORE re-give per the bug-1607 lesson) then issues loadouts + displaces papers; because the trio is cleared, every later death/dbno/respawn/spectate/reconnect/join arms through the untouched normal path automatically. coop_blownOnDamage remains as the failsafe for unscripted busts.

E5 ANY ALARM GOES LOUD THE SAME WAY: already fully wired - alarm_system_master (alarm_system.scr:704) -> takeAllDisguises -> coop_armOnBlown tail (itemhandler.scr:1162). Engine side, level.m_bAlarm voids is_disguised globally per frame. The permanent takeAllDisguises-on-alarm deviation is KEPT deliberately: expectation 5 demands every later lifecycle event spawn loud, which permanence delivers; this resolves the R6 open question in favor of the current code. Zero new code.

E6 ALL AI PLAY VANILLA SCRIPTS AND ANIMS: nothing suppresses or rewrites AI behavior - the whole-window gate stays retired (coop_stealthNoAggro stays 0 and its two dead setcvar lift sites in m2l2a.scr are deleted as dead wiring), so the per-target engine-flag gates make an undisguised player fair game the same frame while a disguised one is handled by the engine's native disguise thinks (salute/sentry/officer/none exactly as typed in the BSP+script). The bug-1637 cardgame shim (already in tree) lets the retail card manager actually run; the paperPassAll deferral removes the one anomaly (frozen guard) this feature ever introduced; the 12 retail bust sites in maps/m2l2a.scr stay verbatim. Residual risk (replica cloning / prone personality rolls on scene actors) is a documented playtest watch item, with optional one-line per-target is_disguised gates in aimaneuver.scr and wounded.scr:219 as hardening.

E7 LOUD EQUALS VANILLA COVER-BLOWN BEHAVIOR: aggro is engine-native, so once players draw weapons parity flips is_disguised same-frame and the untouched threat pipeline (visibility latched at 1.0, threat 10000+), squad sharing, alarm-runner thinks and backup spawners produce exactly vanilla blown behavior; every script gate is constructed to auto-open (per-target: target undisguised = pass; level.alarm = pass; non-disguise state = pass), so no script layer can dampen loud combat. The scripted bust labels (sentry1alarm, sentry2thing, ohnothenaxos1, cardplayersdeath, waitForEnemy) keep their retail attackplayer semantics.

PRESERVED SYSTEMS: naxos hold-USE sabotage (coop_naxosSabotage), caught-in-the-act via guy1-3 cansee, objective toasts (coop_objToastStart + both coop_obj_toast_all calls) and blown-on-damage are untouched except for deleting the two now-dead setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0 lines that sit next to their coop_armOnBlown calls.
file_changes: hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/autoexec.cfg:1175 - seta coop_stealthStart 0 -> 1 (the ONLY switch that turns the layer back on). Line 1176 coop_stealthNoAggro stays 0: retired, never re-enabled.
hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/coop_defaults.cfg:207 - same flip, update the OFF-per-user comment to record the re-enable decision and date.

hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/coop_mod/itemhandler.scr - MICRO-FIX 1 (bug-1631 deferral): in coop_paperPassAll (:1176), replace the immediate 'local.guard type_disguise none' (:1181) with a small spawned retirement thread (~12 lines): poll local.guard thinkstate every 0.25s until it is no longer in the disguise state (bounded ~10s; guard-death/NULL exits), THEN issue type_disguise none. MICRO-FIX 2: delete dead label coop_stealthArmOnHurt (:1375-1387, zero callers) per the do-not-leave-two-detectors rule; coop_blownOnDamage is the survivor.

hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/coop_mod/aihandler.scr:1021 - MICRO-FIX 3 (parity completion): disguiseHandler's spotting test changes from the mod flag !flags[coop_isDisguised] to the engine getter (local.p.is_disguised != 1), closing the last mod/engine desync window in the aggro pipeline.

hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/maps/m2l2a.scr - MICRO-FIX 4 (dead wiring): delete the two 'setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0' lines in coop_naxosCaught (~:493) and coop_blownOnDamage (~:592); their adjacent coop_armOnBlown calls are the effective action. NEW GLUE: one line at the top of ohnothenaxos1's coop branch - thread coop_mod/itemhandler.scr::coop_armOnBlown - so the walk-in Naxos bust arms players during the scientists' talk sequence, before they unholster (armOnBlown is idempotent and self-gates on coop_startUnarmed==1; the bust stays LOCAL, no alarm, stealth survivable per the TP-1b keystone).

hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/anim/disguise_enemy.scr and anim/disguise_halt.scr - NEW GLUE (2 lines each, inside the existing coop preamble): if level.coop_startUnarmed == 1, thread coop_mod/itemhandler.scr::coop_armOnBlown. disguise_deny.scr deliberately NOT touched (vanilla DENY is non-hostile).

openmohaa-hzm/code/fgame/actor.cpp ~:9039 (PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise) - E1, the single engine edit: sight-trace target G_GetEntity(0)->centroid -> m_Enemy->centroid, guarded m_Enemy != NULL, behind the existing g_coopDisgParity cvar (parity 0 restores the vanilla entity-0 trace). game.dll only; deploy to BOTH G:\mohaa-gl2\ and the GOG root (bug-1634) and string-scan the packaged dll for g_coopDisgParity before any verdict (bug-1635).

OPTIONAL HARDENING (recommended, one line each, NIL-inert off-map): hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/coop_mod/aimaneuver.scr candidacy check and coop_mod/wounded.scr:219 re-engage each gain a per-target engine is_disguised skip (bug-1639 pattern), so a zero-threat tracking guard is never runto/forceactivated or re-latched mid-interrogation.

PARSE DISCIPLINE for every touched .scr/.cfg: CRLF+ASCII, no em-dash, no bare (-1), no BOM, verify with scratchpad/depthscan2.py before build; build via build.ps1 (covers all three cfg targets + both binary roots).
loud_state_machine:
STATES: [S0 STEALTH] entered at map load (m2l2a.scr:38-42, coop_stealthStart==1): level.coop_noWeapon=true, coop_startUnarmed=1, coop_forcePapersEquip=true. Every body on every lifecycle event spawns unarmed with papers-in-hand and the engine has_disguise latch (itemhandler.scr:710-742). Engine parity computes is_disguised per frame; per-target script gates defer to it. [S1 LOUD-LOCAL] entered exactly once via coop_armOnBlown (itemhandler.scr:1394; idempotency latch = coop_startUnarmed!=1 early-exit, then coop_startUnarmed=0 FIRST). Effects, in the verified order: clear all three flags atomically -> per active+alive player giveWeaponLoadout (armory picks or map default) -> activatePlayerWeapon to displace the papers item -> 'Cover blown - weapons free!'. Because the trio is level-scoped and cleared, every subsequent death/dbno/revive/spectate/reconnect/join arms through the untouched normal inventory path: LOUD persists across all lifecycle events with zero per-event code. Disguise semantics in S1 are VANILLA: a player who re-holsters pre-alarm reads disguised again to un-alerted guards (engine rule), while alerted actors keep their confirmed-enemy state - exactly vanilla cover-blown. [S2 LOUD-ALARM] superset of S1: level.alarm=1 (alarm_system_master) -> takeAllDisguises (permanent: engine latch cleared per player, coop_enableDisguises=false) -> chains coop_armOnBlown. Alarm-off at a switch silences the bell but disguises never return (kept deliberately - satisfies expectation 5's forever-loud).

TRANSITIONS into S1: (t1) any guard's disguise think enters ENEMY or HALT = wrong-papers/officer detection or walked-off-mid-check (NEW hooks in disguise_enemy/halt.scr) - fires during the engine's 3s/1.5s pre-attack grace; (t2) Naxos caught-in-the-act during hold-USE (existing coop_naxosCaught); (t3) walk-in Naxos bust ohnothenaxos1 (NEW one-liner, arms during the scientists' dialogue); (t4) real damage with an attacking german within 1600u (existing coop_blownOnDamage failsafe, 0.25s poll - the bug-1630 lesson that waittill damage is unreliable on players); (t5) uniform item removed (items.scr -> takeAllDisguises tail). TRANSITIONS into S2: any alarm switch doused by an alarm-runner or used by a player (alarm_system_master), from S0 or S1. NO transitions back: armOnBlown's latch is one-way by design; there is no re-stealth mechanic (matches expectations 4/5 verbatim). All triggers are idempotent through the single funnel, so overlapping detections (officer ENEMY + damage + alarm) cannot double-give kits.
why_ledger_safe: Every recorded failure class is either structurally avoided or explicitly re-addressed with its recorded fix: (1604 strip/race class) no takeall is added anywhere; the re-enabled implementation is the POST-1624 corrected one that arms the trio at map load before any spawn, so nothing is ever granted and nothing races - coop_noWeapon blocks future grants only, e1l3 semantics preserved. (1603/1617) the NIL-vs-NULL guards and the InventoryItem-keeps-disguise rule are already in the tree (verified itemhandler.scr:1216, weaponstate) and are not touched. (1607) coop_armOnBlown clears flags BEFORE re-giving - verified at :1395-1401, unchanged. (1624 ordering) the per-spawn papers/latch block already sits ABOVE the :745 early-exit - verified, unchanged. (1631) the ONLY re-proposed item from its failed_attempts is the freeze fix, and it implements exactly the recorded fix direction (defer type_disguise none until the disguise think exits) rather than any of the five failed approaches; the oscillation root is already fixed by the GetCurrentThreat()>0 veto in the tree, and playtest TP-3 confirms it stays gone. (1632) no new per-player container code is written; the new glue passes no entities as thread params and uses only self-gated level flags. (1615/1616/1618/1639) the whole-window cvar stays retired - this design does NOT resurrect coop_stealthNoAggro (its dead lift sites are deleted); all gating remains the shipped per-target engine-flag deference, extended one line further (disguiseHandler:1021) toward full parity; no script ever latches a disguised player - the retail bust sites that do latch are left verbatim because the ledger classifies them as the design. (1636/1637) zero new card-player code: the shim already in tree activates the retail manager, which per the plan must be evaluated before anything is added. (1610/1633/1634/1635) the deploy checklist is baked into the file_changes: build.ps1's three cfg targets + both binary roots, dll string-scan, pk3-timestamp-vs-InitGame check before any playtest verdict. (1619) verification uses the master plan's TP-1..TP-6 script-driven procedures and ST marker grammar, with TP-1b (post-Naxos stealth continuation to a sentry2 level-2 accept) as the keystone and TP-4 (host-out-of-sight client challenge) as the E1 regression test. Finally, the v1 master plan's superseded premises (frozen engine, whole-window gating, D4/D5) are NOT built on - this is the engine-first shape the parity fixes already shipped, reusing only the plan's still-valid assets (bust-site classification, test plan, prevention-not-repair card doctrine).
risks: E1 is the sole engine edit: one line, but it changes challenge initiation for ALL maps with disguise actors; guarded by m_Enemy!=NULL and revertable live via g_coopDisgParity 0. TP-4 is its acceptance test; solo-host behavior is provably identical (m_Enemy IS entity 0).

Nothing in the parity stack (bugs 1638/1639/1631-veto/1637 shim) is playtest-verified yet - this design stacks on four pending-verify changes. Mitigation: TP-1 smoke before any new-glue verdicts; every failure logged to .wolf/buglog.json before fixing.

Scene coherence at 2+ players is unmeasured: replica cloning (coop_aiScale default-on) can duplicate card players/scientists mid-scene, and coop_aiDynamic's 12% prone roll ends in attackentity at the closest player. The optional aimaneuver/wounded one-liners cover the tracking-guard case only; a coop_aiBehav census run on m2l2a is the recommended pre-release check, with a map-scoped exemption as the fallback fix.

DBNO during stealth is empty-handed by design (no pistol), raising bleedout odds in the window; a scripted/fall-damage down does not trigger blownOnDamage (nearby-attacker filter). Accepted as designed; revisit only if playtest shows unfair downs.

paperPassAll deferral changes retirement timing: for up to ~10s the accepting guard remains a live sentry (engine has already demoted him to salute after ACCEPT, so worst case he salutes instead of re-checking). If the poll ever expires with him still in disguise state, the swap is skipped that pass - preferable to the freeze; the retirement thread logs a marker for the playtest.

coop_armOnBlown arms a DBNO player (coop_isActive==1, alive at 100hp) with a kit while down; the revive chain then re-gives. Known edge from R5, believed benign (activatePlayerWeapon no-ops), verify once in TP-5.

The walk-in Naxos bust hook (t3) arms players on a path where vanilla expected them already armed - net new generosity, not a stealth break; the bust stays local and TP-1b must still pass (stealth continues to sentry2 after a QUIET sabotage).
